name: Balatro 2, Prophetic Dreams
author: JohnAceFifty
Lias
description: jake, i thought id let you know. last night i dreamt of balatro but it was different. firstly whenever you play anything like a four of a kind, you'd get scored for four of a kind, then three of a kind, then two of a kind, then high card, so if you have multiple hands in one hand you get scored for all of them. but it was also crazier cause all of the cards had a new prefix for an adjective so one of my cards was a mad 5 of spades. but it was funnier cause they also have a suffix for a proffession. it was funny cause i played four professions of a kind with a mad 5 spade firefiter misspelled.
